text: Planning a trip is exciting, but travel also brings surprises. When I visited Japan last year, I loved learning about new cultures and trying delicious food like fresh sushi. However, language barriers made things difficult. I couldn't read menus or ask for directions, so I used a translation app on my phone. One evening, I got lost in Tokyo, but a kind stranger helped me find my hotel. These moments taught me to be patient and open-minded. Now, looking back, I have wonderful memories of that journey, and I can't wait to travel again.
